title: Dynamic Smart Military network: on-demand Escort, 3/5/8/10 Group Packs (25% share), and Power-Ratio Solo Herd Rotation
note: Policy-driven autonomous Military runner governed by game/hunt-policy.json (Apophis/Unity). Auto-scales T0->T5+ by percentage combat-power ratio. Runs 4 priority lanes: (1) dynamic Escort/Protection when civilians face lawless/pirate risk (0 held when clear), (2) 3/5/8/10-ship coordinated Packs (~25% of Military) against high-tier wildlife and lone NPC pirates, (3) 1-to-1 optimal Solo Herd rotation obeying F38 (keep_herd=2) with instant cooldowns and P5 Trade handover, (4) low-burn XP fallback.
